concept.title: Installing X-Author for Excel in Apttus Omni

conbody.p: You must have an Apttus Omni hosted tenant and the Excel add-in for each user.

note.p: Designers will see both the X-Author Designer and X-Author for Excel tabs in the Excel menu. End users should install the runtime-only add-in and they will see only the X-Author for Excel tab.
